name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Dragonborn goes with neither Sable nor Abjuration.
Either Thorne goes with Evocation or Evocation goes with Halfling.
Between Abjuration and Evocation, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne.
Sable goes with exactly one of Halfling, Human, or Abjuration.

hints.text: From the clue “Dragonborn goes with neither Sable nor Abjuration” — Sable can't go with Dragonborn.
From the clue “Dragonborn goes with neither Sable nor Abjuration” — Dragonborn can't go with Abjuration.
Suppose Lyra went with Evocation — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Lyra goes with Evocation.
Evocation goes with Lyra, so Sable can't go with Evocation.
Evocation goes with Lyra, so Thorne can't go with Evocation.
…but now the clue “Between Abjuration and Evocation, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Lyra does not go with Evocation.

hints.text: Suppose Thorne didn't go with Abjuration — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Thorne does not go with Abjuration.
From the clue “Between Abjuration and Evocation, one goes with Sable and the other with Thorne” — Sable must go with Abjuration.
From the clue “Sable goes with exactly one of Halfling, Human, or Abjuration” — Sable can't go with Halfling.
From the clue “Sable goes with exactly one of Halfling, Human, or Abjuration” — Sable can't go with Human.
…but now Sable has no possible Race left at all — a contradiction.
